author: Unknown

title: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra by Skydance New Media | State of Unreal | GDC 2024
description: Award-winning writer and director Amy Hennig and her team from Skydance New Media gave an exclusive look at their new ensemble adventure Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra at the State of Unreal. Skydance wowed the audience with a real-time cinematic and tools demonstration to showcase 5.4 features, including new Nanite and volumetric rendering.
author: Unknown

title: Learning Agents (5.4)
description: Get familiar with Learning Agents: a machine learning plugin for AI bots. Learning Agents allows you to train your NPCs via reinforcement & imitation learning. It can be used to create game-playing agents, physics-based animations, automated QA bots, and much more!
author: Unknown

title: Live Link Input Device: A new way to use game controllers for performance capture in Unreal Engine 5.4
description: This tutorial explains the new Live Link Input Device plugin and how to use it with a game controller.
author: Unknown

title: Transmedia: Leveraging Skills across Game Design and Filmmaking | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In this panel, we’ll explore the fascinating intersection of game design and filmmaking, and how ROTU has leveraged cross-functional skills and optimization techniques to excel in both areas. We’ll dive into specific examples of how they’ve used these techniques in game development and virtual production.
author: Unknown

title: Ascendant Studios: Building a Big-Budget UE5 Game from Scratch | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Join the Ascendant Studios team as they discuss the trials, tribulations and triumphs they experienced while developing Immortals of Aveum. Founded in 2018 by Bret Robbins as an independent, self-funded studio, Ascendant is one of the first AAA developers to release a fully featured game powered by Unreal Engine 5.1.

Ascendant’s uncharted journey was a series of firsts, from assembling a new team from scratch while navigating the pandemic, to imagining a new fantasy universe and designing a convention-breaking sub-genre, all while learning and building their first-person magic shooter in this brand-new engine. Come discover what these veteran AAA devs learned along the way about starting a new studio in the modern era, converting from UE4 to UE5, changing tech stacks, optimizing for current-gen consoles and more.
author: Unknown

title: The Importance of the Art Department in Visual Storytelling | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
This session will discuss the art department’s role in film and television production and how Unreal Engine and Twinmotion fit in. 

The art department is fundamental to the process of filmmaking. It’s where production decisions are made and accurately visualizing those decisions is critical to communicating and coordinating with the other film departments. 

Join our panel of virtual production and art department experts as we explore the history and evolution of the art department—and the role real-time technology plays in the future of filmmaking.
author: Unknown

title: Blueprints: What, When, Why, and How? | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Blueprints can do a lot of things, but when should you use them, and what can you do with them? This session is a full Blueprint A to Z, useful for first-timers right through to experts; we might even have some useful tips and tricks that you didn’t know about! With Unreal Engine 5, we have introduced a host of new Blueprint capabilities, so join us to find out some pieces you may have missed; we’ll also get you up to speed on some exciting new Blueprint features in UE 5.3 and demonstrate how you can use them both within and to create your pipeline.
author: Unknown

title: Apple Vision Pro Quick Start Guide
description: Apple Vision Pro Quick Start Guide
author: Unknown

title: UMG Viewmodels: Building More Robust and Testable UIs using MVVM | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Join us for an informative presentation where we take a closer look at the newly introduced UMG Viewmodel plugin. We will explore how this plugin can bridge the gap between developers and designers, promoting effective cross-discipline collaboration and improving code maintainability through the adoption of the Model-View-Viewmodel (MVVM) pattern. 

This presentation will provide designers and developers with the knowledge and practical examples they need to setup their first Viewmodel-driven UI, as well as offering a sneak peak into some upcoming features on the roadmap.
author: Unknown

title: Fabulous Content for Unreal Marketplace, UEFN, and Beyond | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In this session, Clinton Crumpler will discuss how his company Dekogon Studios handles creating content, managing assets, working with feedback, and delivering top-tier quality content to users on the marketplace in ways that allow for the best financial and user outcome.
author: Unknown

title: Selling Cars in the Metaverse | Unreal Fest 2023
description: New experience platforms are becoming part of the automotive user journey. In this session, we discuss how you can create an omni-channel communication platform, examine the ROIs of building one, and look at the timelines required. We’ll show the latest versions of engagement platforms and talk about what it took to build these.
author: Unknown

title: Using Unreal Engine to Combat Climate Change in Flight Training | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Climate change has arrived. Rapidly changing technologies on the horizon can shape air travel safety in a variety of ways. New technologies in the cockpit, crew resourcing improvements, and certification processes all factor into the safety equation of air travel. 

Yet, while the rest of the world is preparing for climate change-induced risks, are crew training and preparations keeping up with these increased risks? How does our industry measure climate change risks and ensure our training programs and devices lead the climate change fleet?

Everyday, our industry is seeing the effects of climate change and how they affect air travel worldwide. Large data and technology improvements allow for increased model forecasting within the meteorological industry. What climate change models should be used and what risks deduced to address immediate and long-term risks in our industry?
author: Unknown

title: Making the Most of Sine, Frac, and Modulo | Unreal Fest 2023
description: This is a walkthrough of how to methodically build periodic functions using sine, frac, modulo, and ceil. Rather than just showing equations, this will be a lesson about how to break up a graph into pieces and use other simple periodic functions to create more complex-seeming periodic functions. This will be seen through a lens of materials, so there will be examples such as vertex animation motion and UV manipulation—but the topic is generic enough for anyone interested. The goal is to walk away with the power to think about how to use basic math more creatively.
author: Unknown

title: The Bright Future of Mobile Ray Tracing in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In this session, you’ll learn how the team at Snapdragon Studios enabled ray-traced soft shadows and Lumen global illumination on Adreno GPUs using Vulkan. The first half of this presentation will cover how our engine modifications and low-level optimizations to the shadow denoiser and shader pipeline allowed us to showcase Artifact—the first UE5 mobile ray tracing demo. The second half will cover compute shader optimizations and content decisions that brought our Lumen demo Dragon Alley to Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 devices.
author: Unknown

title: Tackling Autonomous Vehicle Challenges with a Modular Driving Simulation Framework | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Driving simulation has a key role to play in accelerating the development and validation of advanced vehicle systems and autonomous vehicles, enabling testers to run billions of miles of virtual driving. This requires dedicated tools and methodologies; scenarios and models for the environment; and sensors and vehicles that are highly representative of the real world. Putting the human at the center of the design is also essential to ensure that these new technologies will be understood and accepted. 

At AVSimulation, we are developing SCANeR, a versatile engine for automotive systems simulation, leveraging Unreal Engine technology to build and simulate virtual twins of the vehicle and its environment. In this talk, we will present the key features of our solution and explain how we address the challenges facing the automotive industry.
author: Unknown

title: Creating a Common Simulation Core Platform to Build Complex Training Scenarios with Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Lockheed Martin is leveraging the power of UE5 to transform their simulation and training technology pipeline. Find out how their unified simulation engine baseline is being managed and used to create multiple innovative defense focused technologies, including an integration of human-worn sensor fusion used to properly train ground soldiers, and development of a new high-fidelity visual engine to train the next generation of helicopter pilots.
author: Unknown

title: Reimagining Your Brand with Epic Spatial Experiences | Unreal Fest 2023
description: This session will explore the transformative power of spatial experiences in brand marketing. We will delve into the potential of immersive technologies such as augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) to create memorable and interactive brand experiences. Discover how to leverage these spatial experiences to captivate your audience, elevate your brand perception, and drive meaningful customer engagement.
author: Unknown

title: Building Bigger: Changing Your Workflow for Building Worlds instead of Scenes | Unreal Fest 2023
description: You can build a scene, but can you build a world? This talk delves into the tools, workflow nuances, and best practices involved in developing a large, open world in Unreal Engine 5. Topics include getting the most out of One File Per Actor, how to handle co-development within large teams, and common pitfalls to avoid. We’ll also walk through a slate of simple tips and tricks to streamline your world building.
author: Unknown

title: Unlocking Creativity | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this panel discussion, experts from top creative studios will join Epic Games to explore the new and exciting opportunities for leveraging IP across transmedia experiences. 

Today, your stories are no longer confined to their original medium. Characters that start out as traditional linear animation can be transported into playable, interactive experiences for your audience to enjoy. You can even open up your IP and enable fans to create their own content rooted in the world you've created.

Join us to find out about the evolution that's going on in storytelling—and get inspiration on how you can engage and delight your own audience with transmedia IP.
author: Unknown

title: Optimizing UE5: Rethinking Performance Paradigms for High-Quality Visuals - Part 1: Nanite and Lumen | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Unreal Engine’s new graphics features offer incredible power, and have changed the game in terms of performance. But everyone knew the rules for the old game, and some of the new rules may seem counterintuitive if you played the old game. In this first of two sessions, we’ll dive into Nanite and Lumen to show you how you can best leverage these features for making visually sophisticated, performant projects.

title: Automated Dialogue Workflows at Embark Studios | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
At Embark Studios, we aim to create scalable, stable, and easy-to-use workflows in all disciplines. Dialogue in games is commonly associated with large-scale file management, recording and editing schedules, complicated localization workflows, and expensive last-minute changes. Being a small studio with a small audio team, such a giant system has been one of our biggest challenges.

In this talk, I will show how we use state-of-the-art text-to-speech integrated in custom Unreal Editor widgets to convert large amounts of written dialogue lines into usable game assets - in one click. We’ll also cover how we use the LogicDriver plugin to build our own custom Dialogue State Machine system—an extremely versatile and powerful tool to script any Dialogue event in our games.
author: Unknown

title: Building the Future of Real Estate Search in 3D | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
This session will showcase PropVR’s pioneering efforts in revolutionizing the real estate industry through the development of a cutting-edge metaverse experiences for real estate. The session will discuss the PropTech revolution and the integration of real-time experiences into different modules of real estate transactions. 

We’ll cover use of AI in real estate with MetaHumans as we delve into Square Yards’ groundbreaking project for real estate sales AI, the first-ever sales avatar for real estate metaverse. We’ll discuss the significance of real-time experiences in real estate and how PropVR is integrating them into different transaction modules, as well as exploring practical examples and their impact on user engagement. And we’ll explore how PropVR is transforming real estate search and discovery through the development of a groundbreaking metaverse using Unreal Engine.
author: Unknown

title: Look Development with Substrate and Lumen | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this session, we’ll look at how to use the new Substrate Material workflow in Unreal Engine 5 to develop a multi-layered material system. This new workflow offers us more flexibility for our level design, as well as a higher-fidelity look on our shaders.

Materials such as Car Paint greatly benefit from Substrate, since we can fine-tune the percentage of light reflected as specular from a surface when the view is tangent to the surface, add a dirt layer, as well as adding Metallic Flakes or a Pearlescent thin film effect to our material, which can all be controlled in their own layers.
author: Unknown

title: A Gearbox Plugin for Codeless Automated Tests | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
The ever-increasing ambitions of the AAA videogame industry come with exploding design complexity, and keeping quality in check requires ever more ingenuity. That’s why Gearbox created Polaris, an Unreal Engine 5 plugin for automating tests, empowering the people who make the game with user-friendly QA tools so they can create tests that will live throughout the development process.

Polaris enables QA professionals, designers, artists or developers to simulate in-game behavior via automated agents. By running these tests periodically in build pipelines, the team can keep tabs on advancement and regressions over the entire development process.

Polaris is fully integrated within the Unreal Engine ecosystem and project-agnostic. It has a friendly Slate-based GUI and relies on the FTEST system. It integrates well with build systems, including console builds.
author: Unknown

title: Creating 25 Square Miles of Fun with World Partition | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In this session, Vitalii Boiko shares how Pixela Labs has built an attractive pipeline that enables them to take data from OpenStreetMaps, preprocess it with Rhino, export it to Houdini, and procedurally generate spectacular outcomes with Unreal Engine. He’ll reveal how the power of World Partition enables them to have 500 miles of railroads, 300 miles of roads, 15,000 houses, and much more for their game ‘The Daily Dose of Dopamine!’
author: Unknown

title: Using Animation in a Production Environment in UE5 and UEFN | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In this session, we’ll take a deep dive into animation workflows in Unreal Engine. We’ll review the most recent 5.3 engine release and showcase some of the improvements we’ve made over the past couple releases. We will then take a look at some behind-the-scenes footage from a couple of our 2023 GDC demos, and go over some workflows in both UE and UEFN. We’ll conclude with a peek at what our future roadmap may look like, followed by a brief Q&A.
author: Unknown

title: Inside the ‘Yuki-Verse’: Powering an Indie Animation Studio with Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In this session, find out how indie animation studio Chromosphere went from knowing nothing about Unreal Engine to using it to power the creation of an entire universe around their animated character Yuki 7. You’ll hear from Founder and CEO Kevin Dart, Technical Art Director Theresa Latzko, and Animator & Rigging Artist Lauren Hammond.
author: Unknown

title: A New Virtual Reality: Building a 5,000 sqft VR Experience Space for Four Seasons Lake Austin | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
What does it take to appropriately represent a groundbreaking real estate project in virtual reality? In this talk, we’ll look at the challenges in communicating intricate, site-specific architecture, pushing the limits of visual quality in a fully ray-traced VR experience and providing a multi-user wireless experience inside a 5,000 sq. ft. custom showroom.

You’ll gain insights into the challenges faced and the ultimate solutions adopted to ensure an end user experience that aligns with the caliber of the project.
author: Unknown

title: GPU Crash Debugging in Unreal Engine: Tools, Techniques, and Best Practices | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Debugging GPU crashes on PC can be challenging. We'll go over best practices and the tools available in Unreal Engine to debug such crashes. This includes a new GPU breadcrumbs system, which provides the equivalent of a GPU “callstack.” Additionally, we'll examine case studies and discuss classification tools we use internally to automate crash grouping in Jira. This approach allows us to focus on the most critical crashes, eliminating the need for manual digging through logs.
author: Unknown

title: The Use of AR by WWE: A Case Study and Practical Guideline to Implement AR for Live Broadcast | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
This presentation focuses on the use of AR developed by the Virtual Graphics department at WWE and its implementation during live broadcasts powered by Unreal Engine. In the past eighteen months, the department has developed over one hundred AR elements, most of which will be shown during this session. We hope to demonstrate our success with AR graphics rendered and operated live on air. 

The presentation will start with an explanation of the conceptual approach the team takes when developing AR elements and then move into the more practical aspects of our production. This includes a breakdown of our traveling set-up that includes up to five tracked cameras and IR beacons.
author: Unknown

title: Stylization in UEFN | Unreal Fest 2023
description: How do you give an island your very own look through stylization? It can sometimes be challenging. In this talk, we’ll go over some of the ways to solve this. We’ll explore how both regular materials and post-process materials can be utilized to get to your own unique look. The session will cover some of the core principles of materials while also diving into some of the more advanced techniques available in UEFN.
author: Unknown

title: Electric Dreams: From an Idea to a Demo | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In this session, you’ll learn more about the Electric Dreams demo, and find out how a simple idea could be successfully taken to another level using new features in Unreal Engine 5. We’ll spend time taking an in-depth look at the vehicle suspension, tire deformation, and water simulation created with Chaos Physics, as well as touching on the Procedural Content Generation (PCG) framework and Substrate material authoring system.
author: Unknown

title: Unlocking the Potential of Immersive Air Traffic Control Training | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this presentation, Sonia Mina will speak about Adacel’s ongoing mission to improve Air Traffic Control (ATC) simulation realism in a training environment, and why the company chose to transition to a new image generation (IG) solution, AeroScene, powered by Unreal Engine.

She’ll give a brief overview about the importance of immersive experience in air traffic control simulation and training, and discuss how it increases learning retention and eases the transition to the real-world ATC environment. She’ll also reveal how customers’ expectations fueled the IG change at Adacel.

You’ll gain an understanding of how AeroScene leverages the power of Unreal Engine to deliver greater realism in ATC training, as well as learning about the solution’s expanded capabilities to meet the ever-growing customer demands for real-life-like immersive training experiences.
author: Unknown

title: Traditional VFX Assets Versus Real-Time Assets | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this session, we’ll highlight the key differences between building assets for real-time rendering as compared to traditional visual effects. Discover techniques for asset optimization, procedural content generation, LODs, Nanite, texturing, and look development, as well as overall asset design considerations.

Learn essential tips, tricks, and best practices to smoothly transition your asset workflow.
author: Unknown

title: Extending Unreal Insights for Developers | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
This session will provide a deep-dive into the Unreal Insights profiling framework in Unreal Engine, demonstrating how to collect custom data from game systems through the Trace library and how to write custom extensions to visualize such data in the Unreal Insights application.

We’ll talk about the architecture of Trace and Unreal Insights and go through the complete step-by-step process from tracing data in your game code to writing UI code that visualizes it in Unreal Insights. 

This deep dive into Insights’ API and architecture will give you a great starting point to understand our profiling framework and extend it to include any game-specific information your project might require.

The target audience is developers familiar with C++ and working with engine code.
author: Unknown

title: Epic Secondary Educator Summit- Feb 2024
description:
On February 24, 2024 we're hosting the first Epic Secondary Educator Summit of 2024. 

An amazing and diverse group of educators will share the great work they’re doing integrating interactive 3D technology into their learning spaces. Interactive 3D content development is providing countless opportunities for students who want to explore new careers in film, games, advertising, architecture, engineering, and more. Throughout the summit, you’ll get to see how your peers are integrating this immersive technology in their curricula. In the process, they’ll help to demystify the tools behind this fast-growing technology, so you can learn how you can bring this technology to your students without the need to be an expert yourself. 

Join us!
author: Unknown

title: The Infinite Dimensions of the Eiffel Tower’s Digital Twin | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Immerse yourself in the groundbreaking world of the Eiffel Tower’s digital twin—a paradigm shift in the realm of digital monuments. In this session, we delve into the birth of this living and breathing virtual counterpart, unlocking a new dimension of monetization, gamification, and socialization possibilities.

Join us as we explore the boundless opportunities presented by the digital twin, enabling monetization strategies that extend far beyond the physical tower's capacity. From exclusive access to the top floor, to exhilarating jetpack adventures, discover how the virtual Eiffel Tower fosters a thriving economy within its immersive world. Learn how gamification elements engage and captivate users, creating an interactive and unforgettable experience. Witness the integration of AI-driven avatars that guide visitors, providing real-time information and personalized interactions and facilitating social connections within this digital ecosystem.
author: Unknown

title: ICVR’s Real-Time Pipeline | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Join ICVR’s Chris Swiatek and Ihar Heneralau for an inside look at the latest version of their real-time production toolkit for animation, ICVFX, and asset production for games. They’ll break down how production tools and automations can be used to trace and manage all data throughout production, integrate with existing tools, and increase efficiency for your current productions and those in the future.
author: Unknown

title: ICVFX / Virtual Production for Short-Form Media | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Synapse Virtual Production’s Rich Lee, Louise Baker Lee, and Emily Haldeman will explore the pros and cons of kitbashed and premade assets versus entirely custom-made environments. The team will illustrate how leveraging existing elements culled from the Marketplace, Megascans, and so on, can help avoid unnecessary staffing in pipelines used with traditional VFX, and allow for increased flexibility on a virtual production set when you don’t have that much pre-production time. 

This presentation is designed for anyone interested in virtual production, from VAD creators, Unreal Engine operators, VP supervisors to producers, cinematographers, and directors. It will clearly illustrate that while virtual production has proven its advantages for long-form or episodic media, it also has a variety of underutilized advantages for short-form media.
author: Unknown

title: Against the Trend: Using Realistic Engine for Stylized Games | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Join Exalted Studio’s Artistic Director and CEO as he unfolds how he has used Unreal Engine 5 to create a distinctive, stylized game, Big Helmet Heroes, which stands in contrast to the current trend of hyperrealistic games.

Florian de Gesincourt will take you through the evolution of the Big Helmet Heroes IP, from the first mobile game with its technical restrictions to the recent production for PC and consoles. He will share lessons learned from successes and failures, and the importance of understanding what players expect from an IP.

A highlight of the session will be a demonstration of the benefits of using a realistic engine for a stylized game. Utilizing features such as Lumen for real-time lighting, Florian will explain how the engine facilitated the creation of appealing art, how it allowed for concepting directly in the engine by manipulating lights, moods, and assets.
author: Unknown

title: Unlocking the Power of Unreal Engine in the Cloud | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Join us to explore running Unreal Engine workloads in the cloud. We'll cover everything from essential concepts and cost considerations, to the latest advancements and real-world examples. Get ready to unleash your Unreal Engine experiences in the cloud, reaching any device while keeping your IP secure. 

In this session, you'll gain a comprehensive understanding of which Unreal Engine workloads align with cloud environments; learn to navigate the choices between containers and VMs; and discover insights into scaling options, the challenges of handling large-scale projects, and clever techniques to optimize costs. 

You'll also learn the exciting challenges and recent advances in running real-world, large-scale Unreal Engine workloads in the cloud that enable us to unveil streaming the Unreal Editor in the cloud. Say hello to remote collaboration, streamlined training workflows, and the freedom to harness the Editor's power on any device—no installations or hardware worries required!
author: Unknown

title: Architectural Epics: Exploring the Hillside Sample Project with Neoscape and Google Pixel Streaming | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
"Join us for a panel discussion on the iconic architectural sample project Hillside, which aimed to fulfill the 60-year-old vision of Habitat67 in collaboration with Safdie Architects. In this session, you’ll have the opportunity to hear from Epic Games as they delve into the fascinating journey of architectural visualization using Unreal Engine and provide a glimpse of what lies ahead. 

Additionally, we’ll chat with Neoscape and the Google Cloud team as they share insights on the project’s construction and deployment to tens of thousands of people around the world."
author: Unknown

title: Creating an Interactive Never-ending Procedural Music Album with MetaSounds | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Unreal Engine offers an impressive array of tools for creating generative music and sound design. With deep integration into the engine, these tools unlock the potential for developing interactive and procedural music systems that incorporate synchronized visual elements, surpassing previous limitations. MetaSounds and the Quartz system have opened a door to another exciting application for Unreal Engine.

This talk will delve into the innovative “Sonic Lifeforms” technology, which generates professional-sounding soundtracks that continuously reinvent themselves, adapting to real-time parameters and user interactions.

We’ll also explore the development of the interactive music album Sonic Lifeforms - The Never-ending Album that has been released as as an iOS application. This project serves as a good example of the technology’s potential.
author: Unknown

title: Unreal Engine, Twinmotion, and BIM for Landscape Architecture | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Landscape architecture plays an increasingly important role in the development of large, multidisciplinary projects, becoming crucial to the perception of the project from a humanistic and environmental perspective, yet it often struggles to fully engage with traditional BIM, computational design processes, and accurate real-time visualization. These traditional workflows fail to address key characteristics of the landscape design process, ultimately alienating this discipline from the mainstream of other stakeholders’ collaboration methodology and hindering the collective design of the project. 

This session discusses the particular challenges faced by landscape architects and explains a new digital design workflow for the effective design development, integration, delivery, and presentation of landscape projects.
author: Unknown

title: Designing Automotive HMI using XR | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this session, we’ll explore the exciting applications of Extended Reality (XR) technologies in the design process of automotive Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) using Unreal Engine. XR encompasses a range of immersive technologies, including Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), and Mixed Reality (MR), which can be harnessed within the powerful Unreal Engine ecosystem to revolutionize the automotive HMI design workflow. 

Whether you are an experienced HMI designer or new to XR, this session will provide you with valuable insights and practical tips for incorporating these technologies into your automotive HMI design workflow. By the end, you will have a solid understanding of how Unreal Engine and XR can enhance and simplify the design process, enabling you to create exceptional and immersive HMIs.
author: Unknown

title: GRACE Studio Suite: Building a Comprehensive Web-Based Virtual Production Toolset | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this session, we discuss the unique requirements that broadcast television poses for virtual production, and how automated and templatized tools in a highly engineered Unreal Engine control layer can reduce the footprint from many UE specialists to a single video operator.

You’ll get a complete overview of the GRACE Studio Suite that Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology’s Creative Automation & Studio Technology (CAST) team developed with ESPN Studio Operations to drive virtual production on the LED Catalyst Stage in the traditional broadcast pipeline.
author: Unknown

title: Motion Design in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
"The 3D motion design landscape is changing. In this session, you’ll learn how 3D artists are starting to use the incredible real-time power of Unreal Engine to create beautiful motion graphics, product visualizations, and broadcast design for television, film, commercials, and web. 

From the photoreal to the surreal, see how artists are creating mind-bending 3D design and art with the unmatched rendering speed in Unreal Engine. After all, if games can look this good in real time, why can’t motion design?"
author: Unknown

title: Modeling Mode: Creating Props and Buildings in UEFN | Unreal Fest 2023
description: The ability to create your own unique vision is one of the most exciting features of UEFN and the Modeling Mode is the perfect place to start. Join us as we serve up a fun mixture of modeling tools, shaking up old favorites and new ingredients into a finished element that you can use to bring your story to life.
author: Unknown

title: Linear Content Workflows | Unreal Fest 2023
description: This session provinces an overview of structuring a linear content project in Unreal Engine. We will dive deep into details on how best to organize content, set up sequences and shot structures, use subscenes to make departmental nondestructive edits, and learn how to leverage other powerful features of the engine to facilitate linear content workflows.
author: Unknown

title: Quality Design in a Fast-Paced Environment | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Sports Broadcast and Live Events are high-energy / quick-turnover environments where there’s typically only a couple of weeks to a few months to get things done. How can companies and designers prioritize a workflow that balances design and functionality while ensuring that project deadlines are met? Join us to find out.
author: Unknown

title: Qiddiya: Simulating the Saudi Giga-Project with Imerza | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Join Imerza for an in-depth look at how the Saudi Giga-project utilizes Unreal Engine to help make critical decisions with their massive, 500-square-kilometer digital twin. Learn how Imerza is managing complex data pipelines and using the latest engine features like PCG to populate large-scale environments, and find out how they integrate intelligent traffic systems and GIS data to perform complex simulations and predictive analytics.
author: Unknown

title: Building the Audio Inspector: How To Create a Great Workflow Using Data-Oriented User Experience | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
This session will present a way to approach building editor tools in Unreal Engine 5 that focuses on surfacing only the information relevant to the workflow and presenting it immediately and succinctly. 

As a case study, it will explore the development of SweejTech’s Audio Inspector plugin, examining the problem it aimed to solve, revealing how information is presented and refreshed using the Slate UI system, and highlighting its widespread adoption through the Unreal Engine Marketplace. 

The session will also include other dives into workflow development from SweejTech’s in-development products, which will focus on content creation and live-editing flows. 

We’ll present a tool development philosophy that focuses on data-oriented user experience, rather than the more traditional object-oriented user experience, and show how that can help teams and individuals work at scale in Unreal Engine 5.
author: Unknown

title: Making a Movie in the Cloud: Empowering Collaborative Filmmaking | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
"Discover the potential of cloud technology in film production as we explore the concept of a Virtual Art Department. This session immerses participants in a space of seamless collaboration, where artists and creative professionals join forces in a virtual workspace, as we review the process of quickly and effectively setting up a Virtual Art Department to bring a captivating horror movie to life. 

Explore the power of cloud-based collaboration and learn how to harness cloud capabilities. You’ll get practical insights and real-world examples of leveraging the Virtual Art Department in the cloud and enabling creators to expand their movie-making endeavors to new heights."
author: Unknown

title: Creating Visual Effects with Niagara Fluids, Sparse Volume Textures, and Heterogeneous Volumes in UE | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
"Looking to create realistic fire, water, and smoke in UE5? This session is for you!

Niagara Fluids enables artists to easily author complex volumetric simulations such as fire, water, and smoke in Unreal Engine 5. Newer work leverages compact and efficient Sparse Volume Textures for caching to make real-time playback possible. Rendering with Heterogeneous Volume realistically integrates these sparse volumetric assets into your scene while giving full control over environment lighting. 

In this session, you’ll learn how to adapt this powerful new workflow to your cinematic pipeline."
author: Unknown

title: Stylization in Animation and FX | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Join us for a dive into various approaches to stylization techniques with animation and FX. This presentation will explore a number of ways of using Sequencer, the Animation Editor, Control Rig, and the Material Editor, to get stylized animation and effects in Unreal Engine.
author: Unknown

title: Streaming Memories: Democratizing Immersive Experiences with Pixel Streaming and Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description: This session delves into how Pixel Streaming and Unreal Engine democratize immersive experiences, fostering deep connections without high-end gear. Discover how these accessible encounters rewrite consumer engagement, leaving indelible imprints that defy convention. Whether you’re a marketer seeking innovation or just a curious mind, join us to explore the future of accessible memory making.
author: Unknown

title: The Role of SMPTE 2110 in Future Creative Productions | Unreal Fest 2023
description: This talk will focus on the need for greater flexibility in virtual production and the role that SMPTE 2110 will play in bringing that to every facet of a project. We will discuss the use of hardware, outline the SMPTE standards, and examine the impact on scalable architecture.
author: Unknown

title: Developing for OpenXR with UE5 | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Join us for this presentation on how to develop for OpenXR in Unreal Engine 5. We’ll cover how to set up your development environment for both PC and mobile, take a look at OpenXR extensions/concepts/plugins, review the available UE5 XR components and functions, and offer some general tips and tricks.
author: Unknown

title: Advanced Debugging in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
"Are you tired of relying on the same old PrintString for bug hunting? Boring! It's time to level up your Unreal Engine debugging skills!

Join Unreal Engine Evangelist Ari Arnbjörnsson for a wild ride through advanced techniques and tools that will make bugs quake in their boots!"
author: Unknown

title: Fortnite Championship Series in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Interested in Esports production of Fortnite Competitive Series? Join Technical Product Manager Warren Drones, Blast TV's Head of Innovation, Bjarke Aagaard along with WAR Creative Director, Loren Judah for a breakdown of how Unreal Engine was used to create a broadcast and live events production package.
author: Unknown

title: Reimagining the Horror: Lessons Learned from ‘Layers of Fear’ | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this session, Anshar Studio CEO Lukasz Hacura shares the company’s experience of reimagining Layers of Fear, with the new version released in June 2023. He’ll reveal how they melded Layers of Fear 1 from 2016 and Layers of Fear 2 from 2019 into a singular, cohesive gaming experience. 

Created in partnership with the original creator and current publisher Bloober Team, Layers of Fear (2023) is one of the pioneering projects to develop a full game in Unreal Engine 5, compatible with both Gen 9 consoles and PC. We look forward to sharing the insights we’ve gained through this journey, spanning technical aspects, artistic creativity, design strategies, and the marketing approach of a horror game reimagined.
author: Unknown

title: Using Previs and Techvis to Make Smarter Decisions | Unreal Fest 2023
description: This panel will look into how Unreal Engine is used for previs and techvis on some of your favorite TV shows, including 'The Last of Us' and MrBeast. You’ll hear from the team who used it to make smarter decisions before going on set.
author: Unknown

title: Interoperability: The Epitome of Better Together! | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Gone are the days of locked-down, proprietary solutions that purport to solve complex real-world problems. The solutions of today demand all sectors and segments of industry, government, and academia to collaborate in creating flexible, interoperable, and scalable solutions. We are now beginning to see the positive results of investments in collaboration that are accelerating the development of significantly modernized solutions ranging from hyperrealistic simulations for aerospace and defense, to the creation of dynamic and distributed digital twins enabling unprecedented insights into the world around us.
author: Unknown

title: Optimizing UE5: Rethinking Performance Paradigms for High-Quality Visuals - Pt 2: Supporting Systems | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Following on from our first ‘Optimizing UE5’ session focused on Nanite and Lumen, in this second and concluding part, we'll continue our discussion of how you can build visually sophisticated, performant experiences using VSMs, TSR, and World Partition, and how you can scale that content across a wide variety of platforms.
author: Unknown

title: Managing Audiences of All Ages at Scale: Considerations and Opportunities | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Game account systems increasingly need to manage players of all ages, across the globe. In this session, we’ll review the compliance landscape and its impact on games and platforms. We’ll also demonstrate how collaboration can improve the experience for all players while increasing ROI for developers.
author: Unknown

title: Procedural Content Generation Tools in UE5: Overview and Roadmap | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In this session, Arran Langmead will demonstrate the new procedural tools in UE5. A brand new plugin for UE 5.2, PCG is a node-based procedural placement tool that will change the way you build levels. Starting with an overview of some example PCG assets, we’ll look into how nodes are made and how you can build complex logic to create incredible procedural assets, before giving you a glimpse of what’s coming next.
author: Unknown

title: How NASA Is Using Simulations and Game Engine Technologies to Help Get Us Back to the Moon | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Part one of this session will give an overview of some of the Artemis-focused simulation and visualization systems NASA is building and using at the Johnson Space Center for early analysis and future training for going to the South Pole of the Moon. 

The second part will dive into the details of NASA/JSC’s simulation and visualization applications that are built with Unreal Engine 5, including technical accomplishments and challenges with desktop, video wall, and VR systems.
author: Unknown

title: Unleashing the Power of Unreal Engine: Animation Pipeline for Artists and Studios | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Dive deep into the fascinating world of animation production in Unreal Engine. Whether you’re a solo animator crafting your passion project or a dynamic studio seeking to push creative boundaries, this talk is your ticket to unlocking the full potential of Unreal Engine’s animation pipeline. Join Solution Architect Gaurav Mathur to discover key elements of building an efficient and collaborative animation pipeline fueling your artistic vision.

Grab your imagination and get ready to be inspired!
author: Unknown

title: Developer Iteration and Efficiency in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Join us to learn about the current and future plans for evolving Unreal Engine’s content processing pipelines to meet the needs of rapid developer iteration and improve efficiency for distributed teams.
author: Unknown

title: Features and Tips for UE in ’23 | Unreal Fest 2023
description: In the ever-changing, constantly iterating world of real-time, it’s hard to keep up with what you need to know. Join Evangelist Chris Murphy for a whirlwind tour of some of the newer features added to the engine (with relevant Unreal Fest sessions to look for), concepts to be aware of, and productivity-boosting tips to keep you at the top of your game!
author: Unknown

title: Developing Mobile Games with Unreal Engine: Rendering and Workflows
description: Learn how to leverage the capabilities of Unreal Engine to build modern mobile games. This session will go through the recently added mobile rendering features and show how they can improve the visual quality and performance of your games. We’ll also cover the mobile-specific tools and workflows used to efficiently iterate on the Android and iOS platforms.
author: Unknown

title: The World is Your Canvas: Building 3D Global-Scale Real or Imaginary Worlds - 2023 Update! | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Time has flown since last year’s session during which experts in geospatial data shared their experience and visions of future development with Unreal Engine. This session is back this year with an extended panel and plenty of evolutions to discuss, from AI to Standards.
author: Unknown

title: State Trees and Smart Objects: Data-Driven State Machine Workflows for Open World AI Designs | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Since the launch of Unreal Engine 5, a lot of work has been put into the State Tree and Smart Objects technology as a more flexible way to manage different parts of your AI workflows than Behavior Trees, with data-binding capabilities that allow for easily passing data around between different states. 

Join us as we discuss the evolution of the State Tree technology, and showcase a few examples of building simple behaviors, as well as debugging them with the new State Tree Debugger. We’ll also provide a sneak peek at where we want to take the Smart Objects workflows in the near future to make them that much more flexible for designers, artists, and animators alike.
author: Unknown

title: LiveLink XR
description: Use LiveLink with XR devices through the LiveLinkXR plugin.
author: Unknown

title: Beyond the Bricks: LEGO® Entertainment Goes Real-Time | Unreal Fest 2023
description: There are few more trusted or endearing brands for kids and parents alike than the LEGO® brand. Beyond their bricks, the LEGO Group has been capturing audiences' imagination with animated stories from films to TV series. Join this panel as we hear how and why LEGO Entertainment is transitioning several of their most trusted series to real-time pipelines in Unreal Engine and meet the studios that are helping them do it.
author: Unknown

title: Project Avalanche: a Dedicated Toolset for Motion and Broadcast Graphics | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Project Avalanche is a dedicated toolset for motion and broadcast graphics in Unreal Engine. It combines the robust 3D and animation features of the engine with 2D layer design tools for a new hybrid workflow familiar to existing designers. This enables users to easily create on-air compatible graphics as well as high-end 3D product design and advertising visuals.
author: Unknown

title: Collision Data in UE5: Practical Tips for Managing Collision Settings & Queries | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Collision data is largely defined by content creators, but its users are mostly systems written by programmers. Big games have more collision data, and more systems using it. Unreal Engine provides a great framework for collision, but problems can emerge at scale.

In this talk, I’ll share some of the lessons we learned developing Hogwarts Legacy, and the strategies we’ve employed on our latest project. I’ll share some best practices and practical suggestions for managing collision settings, tips for writing collision queries more effectively, and insights into performance. In the process, I’ll give an overview of much of Unreal Engine’s collision framework.
author: Unknown

title: Character Technology for Film and Games: Rig Once, Animate Anywhere | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Discover the game-changing power of Ozone Story Tech. Join us as we talk through integrating seamless animation collaboration across various applications. Dive into the captivating Like! animated short, which showcases stunning emotions in stylized characters as our character Dee engages with Social Media for the first time. 

Imagine a future of real-time storytelling with zero compromises. Ozone Story Tech delivers feature film-quality characters in games, virtual production, and traditional animation pipelines, all in real time. Don’t miss this opportunity to revolutionize your creative process.
author: Unknown

title: Building a Business Creating the Metaverse | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Step into a world brimming with untapped potential as our panel of innovative creative leaders unveil the most exciting emerging opportunities in the metaverse and how to seize them. From discussing the latest disruptive technologies to identifying new markets, join us for a live conversation that will ignite your entrepreneurial spirit and inspire you on your path to building a business doing what you love.
author: Unknown

title: Advancing Automotive Visuals with ICVFX in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Step into the evolving world of in-camera visual effects (ICVFX), as we spotlight the latest in automotive LED stage content. This panel will delve into the mechanics of integrating vehicles within virtual production stages, emphasizing the specialized content requisites of such pioneering endeavors. 

NantStudios will present their production workflows, offering insights into the creation and optimization of content for diverse segments of automotive commercial production. As we conclude, we’ll cast a spotlight on the future, discussing the next generation of modular LED stages and the integration of automotive motion bases. Join us for a comprehensive exploration of the next chapter in automotive.
author: Unknown

title: Large-Scale 3D Digital Twins with AI and Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
Creating 3D Digital Twins is a challenging and time-consuming task, requiring the combination of many technologies and in particular an extensive use of the latest AI technologies. Join us to find out how AI and Unreal Engine are being used to enhance large-scale 3D digital twins that are being built by Blackshark.AI leveraging UE and Quixel assets. 

Hannes Walter, VP of Product Management at Blackshark.AI will demonstrate how Quixel and other Unreal Engine capabilities can further improve the quality of the results. In addition, he will present the most recent results obtained by Blackshark.
author: Unknown

title: Streamlining Film Production with Unreal Engine 5 | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this session, we’ll take you through the intricacies of crafting a comprehensive map designed to streamline film production through the cutting-edge capabilities of Unreal Engine 5. We’ll delve into the process of designing, assembling, and refining a dynamic environment that is tailored for filmmaking workflow. 

You’ll get insights into leveraging Unreal Engine 5's advanced tools to enhance visual storytelling, streamline production processes, and attain cinematic levels of realism. You’ll also learn how to work with a production designer, and iterate using their understanding and guidance; utilize tools created with Unreal Engine 5 by technical artists; and achieve cinematic lighting to fit the cinematographer’s vision.
author: Unknown

title: Getting the Most out of Epic Games Store and Epic Online Services | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this session, we’ll delve into the opportunities available to you with Epic Games Store and Epic Online Services across both developing your game and bringing it to market.

We’ll begin by recapping the store’s recent progress, including a discussion of self-publishing tools and Epic Rewards. We’ll also provide some insights on best practices when distributing on the Epic Games Store. Additionally, we will explore strategies for crossplay development, which includes the use of Epic Online Services. Finally, we’ll conclude with a peek at the roadmap for the near future before opening up to Q&A.
author: Unknown

title: Building Mobile Games with UE5 | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
This session will explore lessons learned from a career in mobile game development. Velin Tchalakov, Senior Mobile Gameplay Programmer on ‘Fortnite’, talks about the workflows, lessons, hacks, and mindset you should keep when developing for mobile in UE.

The talk is accessible to developers from all areas and levels of expertise.
author: Unknown

title: Rigging in Unreal Engine with Control Rig and the Skeletal Editor | Unreal Fest 2023
description: This session will explore the latest additions to Unreal Engine’s rigging toolset. Using Control Rig and the brand new Skeletal Editor, we’ll show you how to utilize techniques such as creating skeletons directly in the engine and adding dynamic motion rigs to bring your animations to life.
author: Unknown

title: Journey into Real-Time Animation | Unreal Fest 2023
description: More and more animation studios are transitioning from their linear CG pipelines to nonlinear real-time pipelines leveraging Unreal Engine. Join our panel, which includes team members from Nickelodeon, Digital Dimension, and Steamroller Animation, as they share their first hand experience on the benefits and challenges of developing new tools and creative workflows with real-time technology.
author: Unknown

title: Lotus Cars: Fully Integrated with Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description: This session provides an overview of how Lotus Cars has integrated Unreal Engine throughout the business. Lotus currently uses Unreal Engine as its main visualization software for all design developments, and all marketing films and product configurators are also produced in it. Alongside that, Lotus now runs Unreal Engine live on the in-car displays, as well using it to create pre-rendered content for brand spaces.
author: Unknown

title: State of the Union: Broadcast & Live Events | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Unreal Engine has gained massive adoption in both broadcast and live events industries. This session will provide examples of how Unreal Engine and other tools from Epic Games help bring live media & entertainment new abilities to deliver audience engagement and monetization opportunities through high-fidelity visualization and interactivity.
author: Unknown

title: Sounds Good: Unreal Engine Audio | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Crafting a believable immersive audio experience is a cornerstone of making great player experiences. Join us to hear about the latest updates to the UE5 audio engine that will not only make it easier for your audio team to express their creative designs, but also help them collaborate deeply in the same tool set with the rest of your team.
author: Unknown

title: Using Niagara Caches
description: Niagara simulations can now be cached to a SimCache actor. This tutorial explains a technique to re-use a cache that has been previously generated.
author: Unknown

title: Phygital Connection: Bridging Physical and Virtual Worlds with Unreal in Retail & Public Spaces | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
SoWhen? has dedicated the past decade to establishing meaningful connections between brands and their audiences in various retail environments, event venues, and public spaces. Leveraging the flexibility of Unreal Engine, we have unlocked the potential to offer virtual worlds with alternative forms of control and interaction beyond traditional touch screens and buttons.

In this session, we’ll delve into the realm of phygital and immersive experiences, enabling the public to engage with virtual universes through gestures and connected physical objects, and even through fun interactions with virtual characters. As the boundaries between the physical and digital worlds continue to blur, the enchantment of this merging is heightened.

We are thrilled to present real-world examples from our valued clients that demonstrate the transformative power of these innovative approaches. Join us for a journey into the world of blending realities through Unreal Engine.
author: Unknown

title: Demystifying Input in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description: Unreal Engine is packed with different systems that need to react to various inputs, but it can be unclear how they interact and are prioritized. Join Cody Albert for a deep dive into the journey of an input event in Unreal Engine, as he untangles the various UI and gameplay systems and shares a few tips and tricks for debugging problems when they arise.
author: Unknown

title: State of the Union: Virtual Production | Unreal Fest 2023
description: The only constant with virtual production is evolution. Each Unreal Engine release brings new innovations and improvements that advance real-time workflows for filmmakers. Catch up on the latest updates and get a preview of what’s coming up next for visualization, in-camera VFX, post-production, and everything in between from Lead Technical Product Manager Ryan Mayeda in this sneak peek into the roadmap for Unreal Engine 5.4.
author: Unknown

title: Photoreal Digital Actors from Capture to Final Render: a ‘Blue Dot’ Case Study | Unreal Fest 2023
description: As Unreal Engine continues to raise the bar for real-time photoreal worlds, there is more and more demand to populate these worlds with photoreal digital humans. Recently, Epic’s 3Lateral team put together an impressive showcase of these digital human technologies in a short film called Blue Dot. Join us as we break down the technologies and artistry responsible for creating digital Radivoje Bukvić for Blue Dot while trying to stay true to the actor's performance at every stage.
author: Unknown

title: Creating in Fortnite | Guest: FutureTrash (aka FOAD)
description:
Join us for the next Creating in Fortnite livestream on December 20 at 2 PM ET 💥

☑️ Latest UEFN and Creative News
☑️ Design planning
☑️ Special Guest: Future Trash
author: Unknown

title: Epic Developer Fireside Chats - Music in Gaming
description:
Event Info: A new, live event where we bring in Epic developer guests for a cozy fireside chat about their journeys, experiences, and to answer questions you have for them relating to their backgrounds, skills, and experiences! This event will be held here, on our official Fortnite Create Discord, in the ⁠epic-fireside-chat channel – where you can chat along with the conversation!

In honor of Patchwork devices launching, we’re grabbing some warm coffee, starting up the fire, and having a chat all about music design in gaming with Harmonix Epic developers!

🎸  Have questions around how music can enhance immersion in your experiences? 
🎸Wondering how to best use music to evoke emotion in your players? 
🎸Curious to hear how to motivate players through music? 

The team would love to share this and more!
author: Unknown

title: Unreal VR + Cesium + Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles
description: Here’s a quick tutorial to get you started with Cesium for Unreal & Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles in a UE Virtual Reality environment.
author: Unknown

title: Extending Unreal Engine to Create the StoryTech of ‘Hogwarts Legacy’ | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
In this session, we’ll outline how we extended the core capabilities of Unreal Engine to create solutions customized for the advanced storytelling needs of our Hogwarts Legacy production. Unreal Engine was at the heart of all of our StoryTech solutions, from scripted mission flow, to full cinematics generated at runtime. These solutions were used to drive the foreground storytelling, as well as filling the background with ambient life. They facilitated our daily production reviews, and were even used to make trailers and other marketing materials.

In this session, we’ll review key extensions made to the Details panel, the Node Graph Editor, preview scenes, and even the Sequencer timeline. Participants will get a taste of the possibilities provided by the Unreal Engine, beyond what comes out of the box, and gain new ideas for meeting the custom needs of their own projects.
author: Unknown

title: ‘Hogwarts Legacy’: An Inside Look at Developing a Cross-Platform Open World Game in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest 2023
description:
During this session, WB Games Avalanche tech leads will share the successful journey to get Hogwarts Legacy shipped across Sony PlayStation 5 and 4, Microsoft Xbox Series X/S and Xbox One, PC Steam, Epic Games Store, and Nintendo Switch.

We will cover development best practices for project setup, code and content submission guidelines and production tools, Unreal Engine assets data validation, CI and build distribution, game automation, profiling tools, and Unreal Engine upgrade process.

We will share details on the new Unreal Engine technologies we embraced, and the custom modifications needed for Hogwarts Legacy game, as well as outlining the key performance bottleneck areas we faced and how we optimized them to ship game at target frame rate.

Participants will get an end-to-end view of the development of a AAA game built with a large team spread across the globe using Unreal Engine, and come away with project setup best practices and performance optimization tips.
author: Unknown

title: Supporting Photorealism through Cinematics
description: In this course from Epic Online Learning, we create a cinematic shoot that takes place in a photorealistic city. Discover how easy it is to create a cinematic sequence with Sequencer; learn how to add camera shake to your shots; and perform the last touch-ups before you render out the final product.
author: Unknown

title: Designing Photoreal Environments for Cinematics
description: In this course from Epic Online Learning, we cover the full range of techniques you need to create large scale cityscapes. Kitbash together existing high-quality assets to create a coherent theme. Learn how to use the Foliage Tool to build up your environment and create a Master Material for more versatility in lighting and color schemes. Populate a city with static signs and animated objects, then composite live-action videos into the scene using the Unreal Engine's Media Player pipeline.
author: Unknown

title: Automate with Custom Dataprep Filters & Operations
description: This tutorial explains how to setup your own custom filters and operations within Dataprep, that can then be used to automate project imports to your own bespoke needs.  This tutorial includes a selection of custom Dataprep Filters & Operations I've put together to get you started, including solutions to link with Web APIs, CSV files and Metadata!
author: Unknown

title: Caching A Groom Simulation in Unreal Engine
description: How to cache a groom in Unreal to support proper motion blur in Movie Render Queue using Temporal Samples.
author: Unknown

title: Exploring Chaos: Flesh, Fluids, and Fractures
description: We are reviewing new and updated tools in Chaos Physics! We will explore how to creatively use fracturing and soft body simulations with the 'Flesh' soft body system and make waves with cutting-edge fluid simulations. Ignite your imagination, shatter boundaries, and get ready to flow into the future!
author: Unknown

title: Introducing the XR Creative Framework for Virtual Production and Beyond | Unreal Fest 2023
description: The XR Creative Framework is a ground-up redesign of the VR Scouting tools that shipped as Experimental in Unreal Engine 5.1, and which unlock so much potential for XR-native foundational editor tools spanning everything from virtual production and previsualization, to animation, design, and more. Join this session to learn how to create a custom tool and use it as inspiration for your own innovative tools to empower new in-engine workflows.
author: Unknown

title: Authoring Secondary Animation in Maya and Unreal with Pose Driver Connect
description: A comprehensive look at authoring secondary animation in Maya and importing into Unreal via Pose Driver Connect.
author: Unknown

title: Stylized Rendering Insights from Japan
description: There are so many great games in Japan using stylized rendering made with Unreal Engine. In this presentation, we will briefly introduce and outline how different kinds of stylization can be achieved. We will also share tips on combining stylized rendering with new UE5 features such as Nanite and Lumen. You will learn what you need to know when creating unique stylized graphics in UE5.
author: Unknown

title: Custom asset validation for Niagara systems
description:
Niagara systems can get pretty complex and often have to comply with various constraints on different platforms. Instead of giving your tech artists a list of dos and don'ts, wouldn't it be better to give them real-time feedback in the Niagara editor and maybe even a "fix now" button?
That's exactly what validation rules are for, so let's see how to use them and how to make your own.
author: Unknown

title: Creating Secondary UVs for nDisplay
description: This guide will cover how to correctly create a second UV channel for the nDisplay projection meshes so that the In-Camera VFX Editor can take full advantage of all of its features.
author: Unknown

title: User Defined Functions in material graph Custom HLSL Node
description: Create custom HLSL code functions inside the Custom node right in the Material editor.
author: Unknown

title: Vegetation Best Practices for UE5
description: The complexity of a vegetation asset can vary greatly between a small flower and a majestic tree towering a forest. This session will share some of the current learnings into the technical limitations of common botanical problems and how users can work around them in their creation pipelines and applications. Topics will cover some of the best practices of when using Nanite but also for non-Nanite applications, to ensure content creation can be scalable across any platforms.
author: Unknown

title: Bringing Megascans Trees to Life
description: Trees have always been one of the most sought after 3D assets in the Megascans library. It is one of the most complicated, time-consuming, and difficult assets to create in the world of computer graphics. This session will take the developers through the journey of bringing the early access Megascans trees onto the Unreal Marketplace. There will be examples of how Quixel’s collective knowledge of field scanning, logistics, deployment, and data processing was brought together to make this happen.
author: Unknown

title: Hairy Situations: Character Grooms in UE5
description: Interested in hearing how Grooms are used in industry? Join Pete Divers from Fika Entertainment for a deep dive into their usage and pipeline!
author: Unknown

title: Unreal Game Sync (UGS) MSI Installer Creation for Easy UGS Distribution
description: This tutorial walks through the steps for a studio to build its own installer with custom Perforce paths for Unreal Game Sync, which is a tool that simplifies custom engine stream management for studios using several streams and/or custom builds of Unreal Engine. The creation of a .MSI installer allows a central IT / source control admin to build UGS from source for the entire company with the required custom parameters, and distribute an easy installer for artists and other users to install on their individual workstations.
author: Unknown

title: Boosting your productivity with Scriptable Tools and PCG
description:
Procedural Content Generation and Scriptable Tools are two Unreal Modules aimed at boosting your creativity and productivity. 

We recently used both of them for a project and wanted to share an example illustrating how powerful they can be when combined together.

his presentation demonstrates what Pixel Streaming is, the use cases it unlocks, and how to get up and running with Pixel Streaming in your projects. title: Vegetation Scanning by Quixel
description:
Plants pose too many problems to capture properly using the photogrammetry method. Often being made up of very thin stems that are difficult to focus, having overlapping elements that obscure the details behind, and being sensitive to wind and wilting, plants require a different approach to effectively scan them.
Scanning plants involves a different technique known as Photometry. At its most basic level, vegetation scanning involves carefully separating plants into individual parts and then scanning the individual parts in 2D. Once scanned, the parts are used to digitally reassemble the plant. The role of the scan operator is to collect, separate, and scan all plant parts necessary to digitally recreate similar plants.

title: Processing of the Habitat 67 Scan Data with the 3D Divider Script
description:
In this tutorial, you can download the Habitat 67 scan data that was used to create the photogrammetry mesh in the Hillside sample project. In total, 3199 images were acquired from a drone, and 207 terrestrial scan stations were used to capture Montreal's architectural icon. 

Because of the large volume of data, it was not easy to process it in RealityCapture and to render the final mesh in Unreal Engine. For this reason, we modified our existing divider script for processing large datasets. The old script only enabled dividing the reconstruction in 2D. The new divider script enables you to divide the reconstruction in 3D, which is very useful for vertical structures. In this tutorial, you'll learn how to use the script and how to easily process large datasets with thousands of images.

title: Virtual Production Visualization Guide - Chapter 1 - Fundamentals
description:
In this first chapter, we will go over everything considered foundational for a successful professional-level shoot such as hardware and software needed, body and facial performance capture solutions, timecode, retargeting, and virtual cameras. These core fundamentals should be established well before anyone calls "Action!" on set. Your shoot will only be as strong as the base we're creating here. As such, this chapter goes broad and deep. This is the first drop in the larger learning path where we'll cover stage tools, shoot prep, shoot day, and content turnover. 

Our goal is to tell you exactly how to set up your own virtual production studio from start to finish. This is not intended to be just some high-level, show-and-tell so we can get quite technical in some areas. But don't let that deter you, this is the exciting part! Where we gaze at an empty canvas, dreaming of what it'll look like when we come out the other side. Now let's get to work!
author: Unknown

title: Export nDisplay Renders Using MRQ
description:
As of Unreal Engine 5.1, Movie Render Queue (MRQ) can now render selected nDisplay viewports to disk for high-fidelity offline or backup content playback. 

This  integration of Unreal Engine / nDisplay with offline rendering workflows has multiple use cases for live events, ICVFX, and VR CAVE applications. The resulting files can then be recompressed to arbitrary codecs or formats that have the necessary bit depth for quality plate playback.

This tutorial will cover the basics of how to export high quality nDisplay viewport renders using MRQ.
author: Unknown

title: Using Web APIs like Google Maps API from Unreal Engine (BP Only)
description:
With the release of the 3D Tiles from the Google Maps Platform in Cesium for Unreal, anybody can have access to worldwide photogrammetry assets on covered locations. It’s wonderful because you can now drive or fly anywhere in the world with the photorealism that provides Unreal Engine. But a Digital twin is more than a soup of 3D polygons. It has to provide semantic data upon request. 

So we wanted to experiment with the other APIs provided by Google to see how one could add services on top of this 3D visualization.

title: How to deal with camera jitter happening on an ICVFX shoot
description:
When filming a scene in the LED Volume, the camera's tracking data may contain small amounts of noise which can cause slight movements or flickering in the footage. This can cause issues, for instance with reflections on bottles and create jagged edges in the image.
The virtual art department may find it difficult to identify these issues in the editor. 
This tutorial offers two solutions:
1- A blueprint that recreates the jitter, allowing editors to anticipate the camera's movements during filming.
2- A Live Link virtual subject that reduces the noise by applying a 'deadband' to the motion captured data while filming on set.
author: Unknown

title: ICVFX : Blueprint to get Color Correction Windows only applied to some of the render nodes
description:
When shooting on a 'volume', using LED walls as a background, you might want to create assets that will only be visible on some of the render nodes. For, instance, a color correction window that will let you color correct the ceiling at the junction of your wall.
In this tutorial, we will create a blueprint actor that will act as a 'manager' : it will turn the visibility on or off of selected color correction windows, depending  on which render node unreal engine is running.
The same logic can be used for any other type of actors...

The machines are named after American cartoonist Rube Goldberg, whose cartoons often depicted comically over-complicated contraptions built to carry out simple tasks through a convoluted series of chain reactions. Perhaps the most well-known example is the board game Mouse Trap.

With the introduction of our new Unreal Learning Kit: Rube Goldberg Machines, students can now build virtual contraptions in Unreal Engine, with the tools developers use to make games like Fortnite.

We go from preparing the physics asset over going into ragdoll and how to use the pose snapshot to blend from the last physical driven pose into a linear animation.
